title: eval-harness: CI hooks + metrics integration for prompt-set regression gating
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Add CI hooks that run eval-harness prompt-set checks and fail PRs on quality regressions beyond configured thresholds. Integrates eval metrics upload to internal metrics service and documents local dev flow.
description:
Motivation: We need deterministic CI-level quality gates for prompt-set regressions so that model/serving changes do not silently degrade downstream correctness. This PR adds GitHub Actions hooks and an eval-harness integration that runs a set of canonical prompt-sets (per-model and per-route) and computes eval metrics. If a metric regresses beyond a configured tolerance the job fails and blocks merge.

What this PR does: - Adds .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml which runs eval-harness in a short-mode for CI (sampled prompts, cached model artifacts) and posts results. - Adds an eval-ci runner in eval-harness/ci that loads per-model prompt-sets from testdata/prompt_sets and runs metrics from metrics/config.json. - Implements a lightweight metrics uploader (eval-harness/ci/uploader.py) that posts JSON to internal eval-metrics service for historical tracking and dashboarding. - Adds configuration for gating thresholds (eval-harness/ci/gating.yaml) and per-repo overrides via .github/eval-gates.yaml. - Adds a dev target (make eval-ci-local) and a docker image (ci/eval-ci.Dockerfile) so contributors can run the same check locally. - Updates README and dev docs with troubleshooting and expected runtimes.

Checklist: - [x] Add GH Action that runs eval checks on PRs to main
- [x] Short-mode eval harness implementation for CI
- [x] Metrics uploader with retry/backoff and auth support
- [x] Per-model gating configuration and defaults
- [x] Docs/howto for running locally
- [x] Basic unit and integration tests for uploader and gating logic

Testing and validation: - Ran the workflow on a branch build in this PR and iterated fixes after initial failures (see CI logs). - Manual runs with the local docker image on M1 and x86 CI runner images. - Added unit tests for gating logic that simulate metric deltas and assert correct pass/fail decisions. - Verified metrics are ingested and show up in the internal eval dashboard (ENG-2390).

Backward compatibility / safety: The default gating thresholds are conservative and opt-in per-repo via .github/eval-gates.yaml. Team leads can tighten thresholds after observing historical distributions. The uploader uses service tokens scoped only to metrics ingestion and will not leak model artifacts.

Rollout plan: - Enable the GH Action on main for redwood repo in staged mode (warning only) for one week to surface false positives. - After one week, flip to blocking mode for routes that have stable baseline metrics. - Provide a migration doc for teams with large prompt-sets to add CI-friendly short-modes.

Notes: See linked tickets ENG-2345 (CI gating implementation) and ENG-2390 (metrics service integration).

merge_commit_message:
squash: eval-harness(ci): add CI prompt regression gating and metrics integration

Adds GH Action, short-mode eval runner, metrics uploader, gating config and docs.

Closes ENG-2345, ENG-2390.
notes: This is intentionally conservative: short-mode uses sampled prompts and baseline distributions to keep CI runtime < 8 minutes. Teams can opt into full prompt-sets via per-repo config. Future work: add per-route importance weighting and automated threshold suggestion based on historical deltas.
